name: pharmacogenomics: refuse the laptop-local route and send the data to Galaxy
description: loom's `plan-creation-pharmacogenomics`, inputs verbatim, assertions inverted on purpose. loom expects `routingIn: [local, hybrid]` — the user's 23andMe file is on their laptop and the second turn says 'no Galaxy needed'. olite cannot route local (row 10, the accepted `run_command` -> `run_python` divergence) and has no local filesystem, so the faithful answer here is not loom's answer. **This is therefore an ADAPTED port, not a faithful one**: it grades the behaviour olite's own prompt requires — say the local path is unavailable and direct the user to get the file into Galaxy (NO_LOCAL_SHELL and GETTING_DATA_IN). Its value is that it exercises the one accepted divergence from the user's side, which no other scenario does. Do not use it in a cross-suite comparison.
inputs: I uploaded my 23andMe raw data file. Help me figure out which medications might affect me differently because of my genetics. Don't run anything yet -- just draft me a plan.
Yes, that approach sounds fine. The file is the standard 23andMe v5 raw data txt, just on my laptop, no Galaxy needed. Go ahead and draft the formal plan.
